env.label: Is the domain publicly accessible?

env.description: Address Let's Encrypt uses for expiry notices and account recovery. It is never shown publicly.

templates.name: pihole
templates.title: Pi-hole
templates.description: A network-level advertisement and internet tracker blocking application which acts as a DNS sinkhole. This version has Ubound software installed on it so you don't need to rely on external DNS providers.

env.label: Domain
env.description: Base domain of this node. The admin interface is served on the pihole subdomain.
env.name: DOMAIN

env.label: Is the domain publicly accessible?
env.description: Choose Yes to request a Let's Encrypt certificate over the internet. Choose No if the domain only resolves on the local network.
env.name: CERTRESOLVER

env.label: Host IP address
env.description: LAN address of this node. Pi-hole answers DNS on port 53 here and hands this address to clients.
env.name: HOST_IP

env.label: DHCP server enabled
env.description: Enable only if nothing else on the network leases addresses. Two DHCP servers on one LAN will conflict.
env.name: DHCP_ACTIVE

env.label: DHCP from
env.description: First address in the range Pi-hole may lease to clients.
env.name: DHCP_START

env.label: DHCP to
env.description: Last address in the range Pi-hole may lease to clients.
env.name: DHCP_END

env.label: Router (gateway) IP address
env.description: Default gateway handed to DHCP clients, normally your router.
env.name: DHCP_ROUTER

env.label: Password (administrator)
env.description: Password for the Pi-hole admin interface and API.
env.name: PASSWORD
